# PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY

# PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY] Contents of this Practice Direction

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY] Title | Number

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY] Scope and Interpretation | Para. 1.1

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY] Commission to be given notice of claims | Para. 2.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY] Assessors | Para. 3.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY] Exclusion of persons from certain proceedings | Para. 4.1

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY] Expenses of Commission | Para. 5.1

## Scope and Interpretation

## 1.1

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 1.1] This Practice Direction applies to certain county court proceedings under the enactments defined in paragraph 1.2.

## 1.2

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 1.2] In this Practice Direction –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 1.2] (1) ‘the 2006 Act’ means the Equality Act 2006 1 ;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 1.2] (2) ‘the 2010 Act’ means the Equality Act 2010 2 ;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 1.2] (3) ‘the Commission’ means the Commission for Equality and Human Rights;

## 1.3

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 1.3] For proceedings which relate to conduct before 1 October 2010, the Practice Direction on Proceedings Under Enactments Relating to Discrimination applies.

## Commission to be given notice of claims

## 2.1

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 2.1] When a claim under section 114 of the 2010 Act is commenced, the claimant must give notice of the commencement of the proceedings to the Commission and file a copy of that notice.

## 2.2

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 2.2] Notice under paragraph 2.1 should be sent either—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 2.2] (1) in hard copy, with the reference “commencement of proceedings”, to—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 2.2] The Commission for Equality and Human Rights Arndale House Arndale Centre Manchester M4 3AQ; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 2.2] (2) by e-mail, to commencementofproceedings@equalityhumanrights.com .

## 2.3

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 2.3] In the event of non-compliance with the requirements of paragraphs 2.1 and 2.2—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 2.3] (1) the court will consider whether any order should be made or any step taken; but

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 2.3] (2) any such order or step should not involve any sanction (including any stay, dismissal or striking out) or costs penalty or other costs order against the claimant.

## Assessors

## 3.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 3.] Rule 35.15 has effect in relation to an assessor who is to be appointed in proceedings under section 114 (7) of the 2010 Act.

## Exclusion of persons from certain proceedings

## 4.1

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.1] In a claim brought under section 114 of the 2010 Act the court may, where it considers it expedient in the interests of national security –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.1] (a) exclude from all or part of the proceedings –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.1] (i) the claimant;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.1] (ii) a representative of the claimant;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.1] (iii) an assessor;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.1] (b) permit a claimant or representative who has been excluded to make a statement to the court before the commencement of the proceedings, or the part of the proceedings, to which the exclusion relates;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.1] (c) take steps to keep secret all or part of the reasons for its decision in the claim.

## 4.2

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.2] In this paragraph, a ‘special advocate’ means a person appointed under section 117(5) of the 2010 Act.

## 4.3

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.3] In proceedings to which this paragraph refers, where the claimant or a representative of the claimant has been excluded from all or part of the proceedings –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.3] (a) the court will inform the Attorney General of the proceedings; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.3] (b) the Attorney General may appoint a special advocate to represent the interests of a claimant in, or in any part of, proceedings to which an exclusion under paragraph 4.1 relates.

## 4.4

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.4] In exercise of its powers under paragraph 4.1(c), the court may order the special advocate not to communicate (directly or indirectly) with any person (including the excluded claimant) –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.4] (a) on any matter discussed or referred to; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.4] (b) with regard to any material disclosed,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.4] during or with reference to any part of the proceedings to which an exclusion under paragraph 4.1 relates.

## 4.5

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 4.5] Where the court makes an order referred to in paragraph 4.4 (or any similar order), the special advocate may apply for permission to seek instructions from, or otherwise to communicate with an excluded person and the court may make directions for that purpose.

## Expenses of Commission

## 5.1

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.1] This paragraph applies where the Commission has, in respect of a claim, provided a claimant with assistance under section 28 of the 2006 Act.

## 5.2

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.2] If the Commission claims a charge for expenses incurred by it in providing such assistance, it must give notice of the claim to –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.2] (a) the court; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.2] (b) the claimant,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.2] within 14 days of determination of the proceedings.

## 5.3

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.3] If notice is given to the court under paragraph 5.2 –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.3] (a) money paid into court for the benefit of the claimant that relates to costs and expenses must not be paid out unless this is permitted by an order of the court; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.3] (b) the court may order the expenses incurred by the Commission to be assessed and paid as if they were costs payable by claimant to own solicitor.

## 5.4

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.4] The court may either –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.4] (a) make a summary assessment of the expenses; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION – PROCEEDINGS UNDER ENACTMENTS RELATING TO EQUALITY > 5.4] (b) order detailed assessment of the expenses by a costs officer.

## Footnotes

## 1. 2006 c. 3.

## 2. 2010 c.15.
